title: MAVERIX: Multimodal Audio-Visual Evaluation and Recognition IndeX

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting ablation tests using single-modality inputs (text-only, video-only, audio-only) during dataset construction to detect and eliminate questions where models can bypass multimodal synthesis and rely on single-modality shortcuts.

Uniformly redistributing the correct multiple-choice answer labels across all eight available options (A-H) to prevent models from artificially inflating scores through inherent preferences for specific option positions.

Implementing a standardized prompt template across all evaluated multimodal models to ensure that performance metrics reflect true capabilities rather than biases introduced by prompt engineering or phrasing.
